stem.text: A set of repeated measurements is made of a fixed quantity. An average of these measurements is calculated.
What is the effect of averaging on the random error and the systematic error in the measurements?

A.text: Random error and systematic error are both reduced.

B.text: Random error and systematic error are both unaffected.

C.text: Random error is reduced but systematic error is unaffected.

D.text: Random error is unaffected but systematic error is reduced.
